name: commitlint
cmd: temp=$(mktemp -d); printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$temp/package.json"; (cd "$temp" && bun add --dev @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional >/dev/null) && printf "module.exports={extends:['@commitlint/config-conventional']};\n" > "$temp/commitlint.config.cjs" && failed=0; for file in commits/*.txt; do echo "COMMITLINT $file"; "$temp/node_modules/.bin/commitlint" --cwd "$temp" < "$file" || failed=1; done; exit "$failed"
